about.title: About Age Calculator
about.description: The Age Calculator determines your exact age in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds based on your birth date. It provides comprehensive age information including next birthday countdown, zodiac sign, and interesting age statistics. This tool is perfect for calculating precise age for official documents, birthday planning, or simply satisfying curiosity about your exact time on Earth. It handles leap years and different calendar systems accurately.

howTo.title: How to Use the Age Calculator

steps.title: Enter Birth Date
steps.description: Select your birth date using the date picker or enter it manually in the correct format.

steps.title: Set Calculation Date
steps.description: Choose the calculation date (defaults to today) or select a future date for age projection.

steps.title: View Age Results
steps.description: Review your exact age displayed in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

steps.title: Check Birthday Countdown
steps.description: See how much time remains until your next birthday celebration.

steps.title: Discover Additional Info
steps.description: Explore your zodiac sign, age milestones, and interesting age statistics.

faq.q: How accurate is the age calculation?
faq.a: The age calculator is extremely accurate, accounting for leap years, different month lengths, and precise time calculations down to the second. It handles all calendar complexities automatically.

faq.q: Can I calculate age for future dates?
faq.a: Yes, you can set any calculation date to see how old you'll be on a specific future date, which is useful for planning milestones, retirement, or other life events.
The calculator determines your Western zodiac sign based on your birth date, covering all 12 traditional astrological signs from Aries to Pisces with accurate date ranges.

faq.q: How does it handle leap year birthdays?
faq.a: For February 29th birthdays, the calculator properly handles leap years and uses February 28th in non-leap years for age calculations, ensuring accuracy across all years.
